items.name: RetroArch
items.description: Cross-platform, sophisticated frontend for the libretro API. Licensed GPLv3.

readme.excerpt:
RetroArch is the reference frontend for the libretro API. Popular examples of implementations for this API includes video game system emulators and game engines as well as more generalized 3D programs. These programs are instantiated as dynamic libraries. We refer to these as "libretro cores".

libretro is an API that exposes generic audio/video/input callbacks. A frontend for libretro (such as RetroArch) handles video output, audio output, input and application lifecycle. A libretro core written in portable C or C++ can run seamlessly on many platforms with very little to no porting effort.

While RetroArch is the reference frontend for libretro, several other projects have used the libretro interface to include support for emulators and/or game engines. libretro is completely open and free for anyone to use.

items.name: mason-data
items.description: Open source postgres read-replica, powered by columnar storage

readme.excerpt:
A drop-in replacement for your Postgres read replica. Same SQL. Same answers. Seconds, not minutes.

- Lightweight: Mason is a single Node.js process you can run anywhere. - Works like a read replica: Choose which tables and columns to sync from your Postgres database, and how each stays in sync: on demand, polling or logical replication. Mason makes them available to query from any Postgres client. - Exceptionally fast: Mason rewrites your Postgres queries to run on DuckDB's columnar engine, in the form DuckDB runs fastest. Analytical queries ( COUNT , SUM , GROUP BY , etc.) over large tables run significantly faster than on Postgres. - Same SQL, same answers: Mason is built from the ground up to match Postgres syntax and behaviour, so you can confidently point your existing SQL queries at Mason, without needing to port them to another SQL dialect (where subtle differences change your results). - Built for AI agents: Give AI agents fast, secure access to your data: a user per agent, role-based access control (RBAC) that limits the tables, columns and rows each one can read, every query logged, and native MCP support.

readme.excerpt:
One beam. Many rays. The fast, beautiful, open-source download manager for Windows, macOS and Linux.

⬇ Download · Website · ▶ Watch the film · Install guide · Browser extension · ☕ Buy me a beam

Prism splits every download into up to 32 parallel connections , keeps them all busy until the last byte, and survives crashes, sleep and pulled cables. Click a link in your browser and Prism takes over; hover a video and grab it as MP4 in the quality you want — or just the MP3 . All of it in a calm, liquid-glass interface with dark and light themes.
